note: The clinical overlap between KDM2B-related disorder and CHARGE syndrome is well-recognized functionally and phenotypically, making the lack of systematic ear/airway imaging a plausible confounder in clinical distinction.

evidence.text: KDM2B and CHD7 share functional and phenotypic relevance, as modulation of fbxl10/kdm2bb rescues organ and craniofacial cartilage phenotypes in chd7-deficient models of CHARGE syndrome.

source.title: Knockdown of fbxl10/kdm2bb rescues chd7 morphant phenotype in a zebrafish model of CHARGE syndrome
source.quote: These results indicate that CHARGE-like phenotypes in zebrafish can be mitigated through modulation of fbxl10 levels and implicate FBXL10 as a possible therapeutic target in CHARGE syndrome.

evidence.text: Patients with KDM2B-related neurodevelopmental disorder present with congenital heart, eye, and urogenital abnormalities overlapping with CHARGE syndrome manifestations, without routine otolaryngologic or temporal bone imaging reported across cohorts.

source.title: Delineation of a KDM2B-related neurodevelopmental disorder and its associated DNA methylation signature
source.quote: Individuals in this cohort present with developmental delay and/or intellectual disability; autism; attention deficit disorder/attention deficit hyperactivity disorder; congenital organ anomalies mainly of the heart, eyes, and urogenital system; and subtle facial dysmorphism.
